modules._overlay_limits_note: the overlay reads the book in capital terms (weights on the sizing capital): R_max, R_jump_max and R_shock_max are ratios to the first sleeve's risk target tau; max_gross_leverage and max_net_leverage are the gross and net leverage limits; per_name_cap is the cap on one symbol's weight; trim_max is the most contracts the trim removes in a day; overlay_covariance is how the overlay's covariance is built (sample: the sample covariance of the last 252 dates; carver: each symbol's sizing standard deviation with exponentially weighted weekly correlations, 26-week span). All required on a futures book; var_limit, jump_risk_limit and max_correlation are retired here and in risk_reporting, and max_leverage at the top level, and each is refused
